text:
Type: flower-shaped candlestick for three candles
Use: holding taper candles on a dining table, sideboard or mantel; dining room, living room
Style: contemporary, glam, Scandinavian
Materials: polished stainless steel
Colors: bright silver
Shape: three five-petal flower cups joined in a cluster at staggered heights, each with a candle socket, standing on slender pin legs, sculptural, compact
Feel: elegant, festive, playful, bright
Goes with: white tablecloths, glassware, grey or dark wood tables, silver accents; contemporary, glam or Scandinavian dining rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Creates atmosphere in the room with a design inspired by nature and the warm glow from the candles.
